summary: SpaceX's rocky public debut — which had previously rattled pre-IPO investor confidence — is now being cited as a cautionary tale for OpenAI's IPO advisers. The combination of tech volatility, stretched AI valuations, and SpaceX's early trading turbulence has pushed OpenAI toward a 2027 delay.

Tech volatility and stretched AI valuations driving IPO delay
SPCX previously fell >3% at premarket during earlier selloff

headline: Apple Stock Price Forecast: Product Price Hikes Trigger Over 6% Drop, May Continue to Correct
summary: Apple shares fell over 6% on June 25 and face continued pressure Friday June 26 as investors weigh whether mid-cycle Mac, iPad, and home device price hikes will hurt unit sales enough to erode revenue growth. DRAM and NAND cost inflation from AI demand is the root cause, with prices projected to surge 58-75% quarter-over-quarter.

headline: 2026 Russell Reconstitution: Twice the friction, increased futures demand at close June 26
summary: The 2026 Russell US Indexes reconstitution is the first under the new semi-annual schedule (replacing annual), doubling rebalancing events and increasing trading friction. CME expects elevated Russell 2000 futures demand at close on June 26 as fund managers reposition around the 237-stock additions to the small-cap index.
